flags.message: The manifest marks the 134-page application PDF truncated. Extracted application.txt reaches the application's conclusion but ends during district-court appendix page 18a, before the complete district-court reasoning and Ninth Circuit order at 68a–78a. The forecast distinguishes available lower-court text from applicants' characterization of the unavailable material. No respondent brief was provisioned; the snapshot's response deadline is October 13, 2026.

The provisioned August 23, 2026 district-court appendix describes some communications as occurring December 8–9, 2026, although the surrounding sequence begins December 8, 2025. These internal date inconsistencies were not corrected or used as later-event evidence. The prediction uses the snapshot's October 2 application, October 6 response request, and October 13, 2026 response deadline. No outcome was retrieved.
